title: PracticePay Patient Financing History and the Credit Builder AutoPay Due Day
content:
When AutoPay is turned on again on a Credit Builder account, days are added to the account's current due day when the borrower's PracticePay plans show recent payment trouble. The facts are read from the ledger of the borrower's PracticePay Patient Financing plans: its returned-payment entries and late-fee entries, by their dates.

## Provision

When a payment on any of the borrower's PracticePay plans was returned in the 12 whole calendar months before today (a line dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month 12 months earlier falls outside them), the PracticePay-return buffer is added; when none was returned but a PracticePay late fee was charged in those months, the PracticePay-late buffer; otherwise no PracticePay buffer.

| Borrower's PracticePay plans in the 12 months | Days added to the due day |
|---|---|
| a payment returned | PracticePay-return buffer: 2 days |
| no payment returned, but a late fee charged | PracticePay-late buffer: 1 day |
| neither, or no PracticePay plan | none |

## Counting the 12 months (hypothetical dates)

Today 27 April: a PracticePay return dated 27 April of the previous year falls outside the 12 months; one dated 28 April of the previous year is counted.
